name: type-driven-design
title_zh: 类型定义评审搭档，专挑靠注释和运行时校验兜底的地方
tagline_zh: 签名里全是裸 string 和 number，约束只活在注释和运行时校验里——它逐条揪出这些地方，把 id、金额。
tagline_en: Raw strings and numbers in signatures, constraints living only in comments and runtime checks — it converts ids.
desc_en: Make types carry proof instead of comments and runtime checks. Use when reviewing or writing type/interface definitions, signatures that pass raw strings/numbers for domain concepts (ids, money, quantities, units), validation logic, or comments stating constraints ("must be positive", "whole units only", "see constants in ../x").
why_zh: 它盯的是「类型没表达出来的那部分语义」，而不是命名风格。注释写「必须为正」、常量藏在 ../x。
why_en: It targets the semantics your types fail to express, not naming style: "must be positive" comments, constants hidden in ../x.
limit_zh: 只做类型与签名的重构建议，不替你改运行时行为、不生成测试、不碰数据库约束和序列化边界。
limit_en: Refactors types and signatures only — no runtime behavior changes, no tests, no DB constraints or serialization boundaries. Needs a language with.
title_en: A type-definition reviewer that hunts down constraints.
